title: 第八章 让你先出手
content_zh:
任天行见任天元出头，脸上立马浮现出几分得意，这任天元可是任家旁族货真价实的练气境四重天，实力在任天行之上。

    “哦？你确定？让你先出手！”原本正要离开的任天一，眉头微皱，回首冷冷说道。

    言语间流露出自信和对任天元的不屑。

    “嘶！”

    其余众人闻言，更是露出了吃惊的表情，这哪是往日畏首畏尾的傻六，竟敢公然叫板练气四重天的任天元，非但如此，还让对方先出手。

    “傻六这是破罐破摔了吗？”

    “这下傻六惨了，恐怕又要睡床几个月了。”

    “练气四重竟被一个傻子叫板，实在是有意思。”

    ……

    众人议论纷纷。

    “你……”

    任天元感觉自己被轻视了，立马怒火中烧，要知道他的修为家族子弟中，虽不是出类拔萃者，但也是有一定的知名度，此时竟然被一个炼体境的傻子轻视，是可忍孰不可忍。

    “看拳！”

    任天元也顾不了许多，心中暗自发誓，一定要将此子打残，随即直接一拳轰出，直捣任天一面门。

    任天一嘴角露出一丝冷笑，脚踩逍遥步法，身子一侧，同时往后一跃，抓着对方的手臂向前一带，任天元身体立马失去了平衡，向前摔去，任天一肩膀用力向前一顶，一记铁山靠，将任天元扔了出去，对方仰面朝天摔了下去。

    众人哗然，无不为任天一的表现震惊，任天元完全蒙了，满面羞红，他一跃而起，想要再次出手。

    “诸位若是不服，可在三个月后的家族子弟武道交流会上一决高下，今日本少有要事在身，恕不奉陪。”

    任天一不给对方任何反击的机会，撂下一句话飘然离去，只留下众人面面相觑。

    任天行脸上的笑容僵在了那里，任天一的话无疑刺激着在场每一位人的神经，他这是向所有人下了战书。
content_en:
When Ren Tianxing saw Ren Tianyuan coming forward, a bit of pride immediately appeared on his face. This Ren Tianyuan was a genuine member of the fourth level of the Qi Cultivation Realm from the Ren family, and his strength was above Ren Tianxing.

    "Oh? Are you sure? I want you to take action first!" Ren Tianyi, who was about to leave, frowned slightly, looked back and said coldly.

    His words showed confidence and disdain for Ren Tianyuan.

    "Hiss!"

    Hearing this, the rest of the people showed even more surprised expressions. How could the timid Silu Liu dare to openly challenge Ren Tianyuan, who was at the fourth level of Qi training?

    "Silly Liu, is this broken?"

    "Silly Liu is in a terrible situation now. I'm afraid he will have to sleep in bed for a few months again."

    "It's really interesting that the fourth level of Qi training was challenged by a fool."

    …

    Everyone was talking about it.

    "You..."

    Ren Tianyuan felt that he had been slighted and immediately became angry. You must know that among the children of his cultivation family, although he is not outstanding, he still has a certain reputation. It is unbearable to be despised by a fool in the body refining realm at this time.

    "Look at the punch!"

    Ren Tianyuan couldn't care less, and secretly swore in his heart that he would cripple this boy, and then punched out directly to Ren Tian's door.

    A sneer appeared at the corner of Ren Tianyi's mouth, and he stepped forward with a carefree footwork. He jumped back on one side and grabbed the opponent's arm. Ren Tianyuan immediately lost his balance and fell forward. Ren Tianyi thrust his shoulder forward hard and threw Ren Tianyuan with an iron mountain support. The opponent fell down on his back.

    Everyone was in an uproar, all shocked by Ren Tianyi's performance. Ren Tianyuan was completely confused and his face was red with shame. He jumped up and wanted to take action again.

    "If you are not convinced, you can have a showdown at the martial arts exchange meeting for family disciples in three months. Japan has few important things to do today, so I will not accompany you."

    Ren Tianyi didn't give the other party any chance to counterattack, he said a word and walked away, leaving everyone looking at each other in shock.

    The smile on Ren Tianxing's face froze. Ren Tianyi's words undoubtedly stimulated the nerves of everyone present. He was issuing a challenge to everyone.
title_en: Chapter 8 Let you make the first move
